items.title: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH as treasury reaches 6.04 million tokens
items.summary: Bitmine bought 12,535 ETH last week, lifting its treasury to 6.04 million tokens and total investment holdings to $15.1 billion.

items.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
items.summary: Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.

items.title: ‘We found room for more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 267 bitcoin for $22 million
items.summary: Strategy's BTC holdings account for around 4% of the total bitcoin supply, with $5.9 billion in paper gains.
